# Every Ballot Counts

> The sourced record of how federal power reaches elections, from the 2026 midterms through 2028. Every factual claim is marked D (a document says it), R (published reporting says it) or [P] (presumed: the site's own inference from the pattern; no source states it).

Run by Amanda, an independent researcher. Opinion is published separately at Presumption of Irregularity ({{ site.opinion_url }}). Contact: {{ site.contact }}

## Pages
- [Tripwire board]({{ '/tripwires/' | absolute_url }}): 21 signals, each with status (fired, armed, not yet), newest entry and dated history.
- [Case Files]({{ '/case-files/' | absolute_url }}): one page per story, with documents, people, timeline and sources.
- [Timeline]({{ '/record/timeline/' | absolute_url }}): every dated, sourced event; data at {{ '/assets/data/timeline.json' | absolute_url }}
- [People map]({{ '/record/people/' | absolute_url }}): careers and sourced ties (work in progress); data at {{ '/assets/data/people.json' | absolute_url }}
- [Architecture map]({{ '/record/architecture/' | absolute_url }}): numbered data flows between agencies, states and vendors; data at {{ '/assets/data/architecture.json' | absolute_url }}
- [System registry]({{ '/record/registry/' | absolute_url }}): one entry per federal system, contract vehicle or data feed.
- [Phrase trail]({{ '/record/phrase-trail/' | absolute_url }}): wording that travels from plans into orders, contracts and filings.
- [Documents]({{ '/record/documents/' | absolute_url }}), [Corrections]({{ '/corrections/' | absolute_url }}), [How this is made]({{ '/how-this-is-made/' | absolute_url }})
